instruction: Notify the owner with the exact action, payout, deadline, risk, prepared artifacts and evidence; continue all reversible work meanwhile.

evidence: Google Maps Car Interior Scrape 6 days left I need a clean, well-structured Excel database pulled from Google Maps that contains automotive upholstery workshops (bengkel jok mobil), car-interior restoration services, and sellers of headliner fabric across Jakarta, Tangerang, Bandung, and every other city on the island of Java. Please extract only three fields—Nama usaha, Nomor telepon, and Alamat lengkap—and drop any listing that does not show a phone number. In addition, keep just the businesses that pass a minimum-review threshold; I will confirm the exact number with you before you begin so you can apply the filter directly during scraping rather than post-processing. The final deliverable is a single Excel file, neatly organised in separate columns and free of duplicates. My target deadline is within a month, but...
